newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Jollibee opens more branches abroad.
newsitem.headline: Jollibee opens more branches abroad.

text.p: Philippine fast food chain owner Jollibee Foods Corp said on Thursday it recently opened three new branches abroad.
In a statement, the company said this brings the number of Jollibee branches abroad to 22.
The newest branches were set up in Hong Kong, Brunei and Vietnam.
"Our global build-up is part of our overall strategy to widen our market base," said Tony Kitchner, Jollibee vice-president for international operations.

Jollibee has opened branches in Dubai, Kuwait, United Arab Emirates, Indonesia, Malaysia, Guam and Bahrain. It is also planning to set up stores in the West Coast of the United States. Jollibee has 190 branches in the Philippines.
